result.evidence_quote: We examined the association between computed tomography (CT)-measured trabecular attenuation at the first lumbar vertebra (L1 CT-attenuation), bone mineral density (BMD), and osteoporosis in patients on hemodialysis.
result.rationale: The study evaluates CT-based osteoporosis screening and bone mineral density in hemodialysis patients. It does not address brain or neural mechanisms, neurological disease, cognition, neural injury, or neurological treatments or biomarkers.
